summary: Completed comprehensive backend API testing for Phase 2 (Digitalisasi Formulir Sukacita). Tested all HTTP endpoints for Cash Advance, Settlement, Vehicles, and Vehicle Usage Logs with RBAC enforcement and entity scoping.

minor_issues.issue: Test expected 'VHL-*' but actual format is 'KSC/VHL-*' (entity-prefixed)
minor_issues.impact: Test expectation was incorrect - actual behavior is correct (entity-scoped numbering)
minor_issues.fix_priority: NONE - Test expectation needs update, not code

minor_issues.issue: Admin can GET documents from ent_kanda while scoped to ent_ksc
minor_issues.impact: This is CORRECT behavior - admin has allowed_entity_ids=[ent_ksc, ent_kanda], so can access both. X-Entity-Id controls CREATE/LIST scope, not GET by ID access control
minor_issues.fix_priority: NONE - Working as designed. Test expectation needs clarification
